'''This Unidentified''' [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was selected as the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Karrid]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], she and her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] in the [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|Battle of Duro]].

==Biography==
When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], her master's former Jedi Mentor, boarded the [[Ascendant Spear]] while the ship was docked at [[Reaver Station]], the Sith woman fought [[Gnost-Dural]], with the help of his fellow [[Unidentified Human male Sith apprentice|Sith Apprentice]] and some help from his master, [[Darth Karrid]]. The trio eventually captured [[Gnost-Dural]] and began to interrogate him.

The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] stayed with the interrogation team while her [[Darth Karrid|master]] and [[Unidentified Human male Sith apprentice|fellow apprentice]] took control of the [[Ascendant Spear]] in order to [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|fight off the Republic Fleet]]. The apprentice was confused at how powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] was with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]], after being taught for years that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark-Side]] was stronger than the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]], she tried to examine his [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]] to see how he won. [[Gnost-Dural]] attempted to use this confusion to redeem her to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light-Side]], there was a momentary bond between the two which quickly faded.

When [[Theron Shan]] used his connection with the [[Ascendant Spear]] to free [[Gnost-Dural]], the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] fled the room, leaving the two interrogators to be killed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and running to tell [[Darth Karrid]] of her [[Gnost-Dural|former mentor's]] escape. [[Gnost-Dural]] ran after the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]], determined to stop her from alerting her [[Darth Karrid|Master]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Apprentice]] jabbed at the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel'Dor]] with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]], this action was dodged and the two engaged in a battle which resulted in the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Apprentice's]] death at [[Gnost-Dural]]'s hands.
